title: promote refuses a source item's parent and discovered_from
findings_note: s328 relay 2026-10-17: a promote source silently drops `parent` and `discovered_from`, as it dropped `short_title` before s328's fix
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing which fields promote applies, or `import`.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `promote` takes the lead and sections from a one-item outline and keeps the item's own fields. An outline field it does not apply should be refused, as s328 made it refuse `short_title` through `ops._SOURCE_FIELD_DEFAULTS`. `parent` and `discovered_from` are still dropped without a word, so an author who puts them in the outline believes they took effect.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests; watch them go red.
2. Add both keys; the refusal message names the key and says to use `set`.
3. CHANGELOG; mutation-check (each key removed).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
